Pricing Operations Manager

Position Summary:
The Pricing Operations Manager is responsible for building and scaling the operational foundation that enables a modern, data-driven pricing organization. This role serves as the bridge between merchandising, finance, technology, and analytics to ensure pricing strategies can be executed efficiently, consistently, and at scale.

This leader will drive the evolution of pricing systems, processes, and capabilities by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and advanced technology. The role is responsible for creating a roadmap for pricing operations, prioritizing technology investments, improving testing and modeling capabilities, and ensuring pricing tools and workflows are aligned with the company's financial objectives and strategic priorities.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the development and continuous improvement of pricing operations, systems, and workflows to support evolving business strategies.
- Champion the adoption of AI and emerging technologies to improve speed, accuracy, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
- Identify opportunities to streamline pricing execution and reduce manual work through automation and AI-enabled solutions while maintaining governance and control.
- Build scalable operational processes that support future business growth.
- Support the development and execution of pricing operations roadmaps, helping align process improvements, technology enhancements, and resource planning with evolving business priorities.
- Manage relationships with external data and technology vendors, including contract oversight, performance monitoring, and service delivery to support business objectives.
- Evaluate systems and data sources that improve the collection, prioritization, and application of competitive pricing information.
- Collaborate across teams to prioritize enhancements and deliver operational improvements.
- Ensure pricing operational capabilities support the organization's evolving pricing strategy and operational targets.
- Establish KPIs, tracking mechanisms, and operational dashboards to measure pricing execution and operational effectiveness.
- Develop governance processes that ensure pricing tools, workflows, and systems remain scalable, accurate, and compliant.
- Measure the business impact of pricing operations initiatives and continuously optimize based on performance outcomes.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree
- 5–8+ years of related experience

This is a hybrid role. Tuesday through Thursday are in-office days at BJ's Club Support Center in Marlborough, MA and Monday and Friday are remote days.

In accordance with the Pay Transparency requirements, the following represents a good faith estimate of the compensation range for this position. At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is $115,000.00 - $146,000.00

We recognize the growing role of AI tools, including ChatGPT, and value familiarity with them. That said, we want to hear from your authentic self. Your application should reflect your own skills, experiences, and insights rather than AI-generated responses.

Job Description

* Role is not remote; it is required to be within commutable distance to the clubs surrounding the upstate NY/Ohio market*

The Regional Perishable Operations Manager will report directly to the Sr Director of Perishables. This multi-unit field leadership role is responsible for overseeing and driving a high level of execution and operational excellence within a network of clubs. This individual will have financial accountability for the clubs they oversee. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the efficient execution of merchandising priorities, displays, and sales initiatives, while leveraging data-driven insights to optimize processes and enhance overall performance.
Key Responsibilities:
Executional Excellence :
- Collaborate closely with the Sr. Director of Perishables to ensure the seamless execution of merchandising programs, marketing campaigns, and product flows across all club locations.
- Work closely with the regional and club teams to maintain consistent standards in quality, ordering, training, and production, fostering a culture of driving sales and enhancing the member experience.
- Identify areas of opportunity for improvement in club execution and implement merchandising strategies to achieve chain-wide consistency.

Data Analysis and Insights :
- Achieve Perishable sales and profitability plans for the region by leveraging data to assess sales and profitability performance, merchandising effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
- Utilize analytical tools and methodologies to generate actionable insights, identify trends, and address opportunities for improvement.
- Collaborate with clubs, regional teams, and Merchandising teams to analyze sales and merchandising data, resolving any operational challenges or opportunities that may arise.

Team Member Development :
- Develop Club Manager, Fresh Manager, and Meat Manager skills to drive consistently high levels of execution, operational excellence, and member service
- Foster a culture of continuous improvement through ongoing data analysis of trends, strength, and opportunities

Communication and Collaboration :
- Establish strong communication channels with the Sr. Director of Perishables, CSC team, Club Operations, and DC Operations to address concerns, share insights, and align on strategic objectives.
- Collaborate with merchandising teams to ensure product selection and offerings align with merchandising segmentation strategy

Training and Succession Planning :
- Work collaboratively with the Sr Director and Talent team to drive high execution of training programs that focus on increasing sales, improving efficiencies, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and company policies.
- Assist in succession planning efforts, identifying and positioning potential candidates for leadership roles within Fresh operations.
- Participate in new club openings to ensure Merchandising & Training consistency with new Team Members Support of the training organization, develop plans to transfer knowledge to club Team Members on perishable areas, from Club Managers to perishable Team Members

Qualifications :
- 5 years of experience in retail merchandising, operations management, or a related field.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools and technologies.
- Excellent communication skills, both oral and written.
- Proficient in BJ's IS, Microsoft Word, and Excel.
- Previous experience in perishable goods merchandising and operations is advantageous.
-

The Regional Manager or Fresh Operations will play a crucial role in driving the success and efficiency of fresh operations at BJ's Wholesale Club, contributing to the overall growth and profitability of the company.
